'''''Furious''''' was the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] serving the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]]. Its crew included a [[Unidentified pilot (Furious)|pilot]] and at least one [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]].<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

==History==
On the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II|Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> the shuttle was to pick up the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], while the droid [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|conducted business]] there on behalf of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]].<ref name="RA" />

When 8t88 arrived at the [[Launch Deck Three]], the shuttle arrived soon after and the droid radioed the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to commend his precision on time, and that he would talk to the pilot's superiors about his punctuality. 8t88 was being pursued by [[Kyle Katarn]], a client that 8t88 tried to double-cross. 8t88 ordered the pilot to drop ''Furious''<nowiki>'</nowiki> ramp instead of land, so that 8t88 could climb aboard as soon as possible.<ref name="RA" />

Katarn managed to shoot off 8t88's [[Limb/Legends|arm]], but a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] from the shuttle helped the droid to board.<ref name="RA" /> The shuttle was going up as the walkway started to retract; a woman who served as one of the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] 8t88 had hired, was on the ramp and was going to the lock as well to escape Katarn, when a stormtrooper at the top of the ramp shot her off. The pilot then flew the ''Furious'' away from the landing platform.<ref name="RA" />
